title: Fmr. FDA, CDC Official on Cyclospora, Food Safety Issues

The conversation highlighted that while the outbreak became widely known in early to mid-July, there were reports suggesting that government agencies had knowledge of the issue weeks prior to public disclosure. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Deep Dive Into The US' Critical Minerals Investment

Investigative Reporter Polly Mosendz discusses her report on how "Trump Is Rewriting Corporate Norms With 211-Mile Arctic Road." Plus, Gracelin Baskaran -- Director of Critical Minerals Security Program at CSIS -- breaks down the global viability of the rare earths trade. Then, Quince Street Strategy Principal Tripp Hornick talks about the domestic-side of the investment, and what it means for companies trying take advantage in a growing industry. (Source: Bloomberg)
